integrity: The statements and proof concern a specified mathematical discretization. No independent proof or historical-priority audit has been performed. Numerical tests are not substitutes for the analytical argument.
limitations: Strictly positive grid data, real exponent \(p>2\), zero reaction, equal spatial spacing, positive generalized step and full coordinatewise reflected-Neumann ghost completion.
The source prints corner ghost identities but not a complete side-ghost closure; other boundary implementations are outside the theorem.
Identity Jacobian only for \(p>3\), without a nonlinear-stability conclusion.
Historical equivalence under broader finite-difference terminology remains possible.
title: Complete positive fixed points and neutral checkerboard modes in a degenerate diffusion update
